topic.title: 15 Things Every 1970s Christmas Party Had — Almost Forgotten
topic.angle: Office parties and neighborhood holiday parties: the punch bowl, fondue, the cheese ball, the aluminum tree, records on the hi-fi and cigarette smoke everywhere. The adults' Christmas the grandkids never saw.
topic.why: Second video in the 'Holidays in the 70s' series. It matches the strong '1970s christmas nostalgia' search, focuses on adult social life and makes an easy cover image (a party in a wood-paneled basement).
